lines.text: 这是我们的房子，这是我们的房子。
lines.en: This house is ours, this house is ours.
lines.character: 格蕾丝·斯图尔特（妮可·基德曼 饰）
lines.note: 中文采豆瓣影评通行译法「这是我们的房子」，重复两遍依 Wikiquote 原文（核证证据：① Wikiquote《The Others (2001 film)》逐字「This house is ours, this house is ours.」：https://en.wikiquote.org/wiki/The_Others_(2001_film)；② 剧本转写逐字「And this house is ours.」：http://www.script-o-rama.com/movie_scripts/o/others-script-transcript-nicole-kidman.html；③ 中文通行译法见豆瓣影评逐字「虽然他们大喊'这是我们的房子'」：https://m.douban.com/movie/review/1008295/）

lines.text: 起初我不明白枕头怎么会在我手里、你为什么一动不动，后来我明白了——已经发生了：我杀了我的孩子们。
lines.en: At first, I couldn't understand what the pillows were doing in my hands and why you didn't move, but then I knew. It had happened. I killed my children.
lines.character: 格蕾丝·斯图尔特（妮可·基德曼 饰）
lines.note: 对照翻译（两来源拼写/标点略异，逐字以 Wikiquote 为准）（核证证据：① Wikiquote 同页逐字：https://en.wikiquote.org/wiki/The_Others_(2001_film)；② IMDb《The Others (2001) - Quotes》逐字「Grace: At first I couldn't understand what the pillows where doing in my hands and why you didn't move, but then I knew, it had happened, I killed my children.」：https://www.imdb.com/title/tt0230600/quotes/）
